questions.stem: I _______ to Beijing last year. I _______ there twice.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时与现在完成时的区别。第一空后有明确过去时间状语last year，必须用一般过去时went；第二空表示'去过某地两次'的经历，用have been to结构，there是副词省略to。B选项have gone表示'去了未回'，不符合'去过两次'的语境；C选项第二空缺少完成时含义；D选项第一空错误使用完成时。口诀：过去时间用过去，经历影响用完成。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The girl _______ is wearing a red coat is my sister.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系词的选择。先行词是The girl（指人），且关系词在从句中作主语（is wearing），故用who。which用于指物；whom用于指人但在从句中作宾语；whose表示'谁的'，在从句中作定语。判断技巧：先看先行词是人还是物，再看关系词在从句中充当什么成分（主语、宾语或定语）。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book _______ by many students yesterday.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时的被动语态。主语The book是'被借'的对象，需用被动语态；时间状语yesterday表明用一般过去时，故选was borrowed（was/were + 过去分词）。B选项是主动语态过去式；C选项是一般现在时被动，时态不符；D选项是主动语态第三人称单数。被动语态结构口诀：被动语态be字变，过去分词跟后面，时态由be来决定。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
- _______ you _______ your homework yet?
- Yes, I _______ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的混合辨析。问句中有yet（已经/还），是现在完成时的标志词，用Have...finished；答句中有明确过去时间状语an hour ago（一小时前），必须用一般过去时finished。A选项第一错用一般过去时；C选项第二空错用完成时；D选项两空都错。解题关键：找时间标志词，yet/never/ever/already/just/so far常与完成时连用，ago/yesterday/last year与一般过去时连用。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The story is very _______. I am _______ in it.
questions.explanation: 本题考查-ing形容词与-ed形容词的区别。interesting（令人感兴趣的）修饰物，指事物本身具有的性质；interested（感到感兴趣的）修饰人，指人的感受，常与in搭配。第一空主语是The story（物），用interesting；第二空主语是I（人），用interested。口诀：-ing形容物，-ed形容人，be interested in是固定搭配。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We need to _______ the problem at the meeting tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。talk about意为'讨论、谈论'，符合句意'我们需要在明天的会议上讨论这个问题'。look after照顾；look for寻找；look up查阅（词典）或向上看。根据宾语the problem（问题），只有talk about搭配合理。解题技巧：根据宾语和语境判断，problem通常与solve/discuss/talk about等词搭配。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The two words are similar but have different _______.
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换与词义辨析。different（不同的）是形容词，后接名词；meaning意为'意思、含义'，是可数名词，复数形式meanings。means意为'方法、手段'；meaningful是形容词'有意义的'；mean是动词'意思是'或形容词'吝啬的'。句意：这两个词相似但含义不同。解题关键：分析句子成分，确定需要名词；根据句意确定是'含义'而非'方法'。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析与固定搭配。aim to do sth.意为'旨在做某事、目的是做某事'，符合语境'该项目旨在帮助学生理解保护环境的重要性'。try to努力做；plan to计划做；want to想要做。虽然语法上都可行，但aim更能体现项目的设计目的和宗旨，且与主语program搭配更正式。解题技巧：完形填空要注意上下文语境的正式程度和搭配习惯。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Our school started a recycling program last month. The program (8)_______ to help students understand the importance of protecting the environment. Every classroom now has three different bins for sorting waste.

I used to throw everything into one bin. (9)_______ now I know that paper, plastic and food waste should be separated. This small change has made a big difference to our school life.

Last Friday, our class visited a local recycling center. We saw how old bottles were (10)_______ new products. The workers there told us that recycling one ton of paper can save 17 trees. I was (11)_______ by this fact.

Since then, I have paid more attention to reducing waste. I always take a reusable bag when going shopping. My classmates also join me in this (12)_______. Together, we hope to make our campus greener.

questions.explanation: 本题考查逻辑关系与连词辨析。前文说'我过去把所有东西扔进一个垃圾桶'，后文说'现在我知道纸、塑料和食物垃圾应该分开'，前后是转折关系，用But（但是）。And表并列；So表结果；Or表选择或否则。解题技巧：完形填空中要重点关注上下文的逻辑关系，通过对比'used to'（过去常常）和'now'（现在）可判断为转折关系。

questions.stem: What should we NOT do during short breaks according to the passage?
options: A. Stand up and stretch our body.
questions.explanation: 本题考查细节理解。根据文章第三段'During these short breaks, you should not look at your phone or computer.'可知，休息时不应该看手机或电脑。A、B、D选项都是文章建议可以做的事情（stand up and stretch、looking at green plants、drinking some water）。解题技巧：细节题要找准关键词定位原文，注意题干中的NOT表示反向选择，不要误选。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Do you often feel tired after studying for a long time? Many students have this problem. Scientists say that taking short breaks during study can help us learn better.

A recent study shows that the human brain cannot focus for hours without rest. When we study continuously, our brain gets tired and cannot remember new information well. However, if we take a 5-minute break every 25 minutes, our memory improves significantly.

During these short breaks, you should not look at your phone or computer. Instead, try to stand up and stretch your body. Looking at green plants or drinking some water also helps. These simple activities give your brain time to process what you have learned.

Some students think that breaks waste time. But in fact, they make your study time more effective. Quality is more important than quantity when it comes to learning.

So next time you feel tired while doing homework, remember to take a short break. Your brain will thank you for it.

questions.stem: What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. Studying longer hours always leads to better grades.
B. Taking breaks is a waste of time for students.
C. Proper rest can improve study efficiency.
D. We should look at phones to relax during breaks.
questions.explanation: 本题考查推理判断。根据文章最后两段，特别是'they make your study time more effective'和'Quality is more important than quantity'可推断出，适当的休息可以提高学习效率。A选项与文意相反（大脑无法长时间专注）；B选项是某些学生的错误观点，已被作者否定；D选项与原文'you should not look at your phone'相悖。解题技巧：推理题要基于原文信息进行合理推断，不能选与原文直接矛盾的选项，也不能选原文直接陈述的内容（那叫细节题）。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word 'significantly' in Paragraph 2 probably mean?
questions.explanation: 本题考查词义猜测。significantly出现在'our memory improves significantly'，前文提到连续学习会使大脑疲劳、记不住新信息，However转折后说每25分钟休息5分钟，记忆应该会'显著地、大大地'提高。greatly（大大地、非常）意思最接近。slowly缓慢地；hardly几乎不；recently最近。解题技巧：利用上下文逻辑关系（However转折）和语义对比（前负后正），以及构词法（significant重要的/显著的 + ly副词后缀）。

options: A. How to Study for Exams
B. The Importance of Taking Breaks
D. Ways to Use Mobile Phones
questions.explanation: 本题考查主旨大意/最佳标题。文章围绕'学习时短暂休息的重要性'展开，第一段点明主题，中间论述原因和方法，最后总结建议。A选项范围太宽（备考），且未突出breaks；C选项只是引子，不是主旨；D选项与文意相反（文章建议休息时别看手机）。B选项准确概括了文章核心。解题技巧：主旨题要抓住首尾段和每段首句，寻找高频词（breaks出现多次），排除以偏概全或偏离主题的选项。

questions.explanation: 本题考查段落主旨句与总分结构。空格位于首段，下文用First（首先）列举了好处，因此此处应是总起句'参加社团有很多好处'。D选项There are many benefits to joining a club.恰好总领全文。A选项表转折，通常用于引出问题的段落；B选项Besides表示递进，用于补充说明，不适合段首总起；C选项是结论句，用于文末；E选项也是结果/感受描述。解题技巧：选句子填空要注意段落结构，首段通常是总述，中间分述，尾段总结。
questions.label: 短文填空
questions.group_passage:
Joining a school club is a great way to enrich your middle school life. (17)_______. First, you can make friends who share the same interests as you. For example, if you love music, the school band is perfect for you.

(18)_______. In the science club, you will do experiments that you cannot do in regular classes. This hands-on experience helps you understand textbook knowledge better.

Moreover, being in a club teaches you time management. (19)_______. You need to balance your study and club activities. This skill will be useful in your future life.

(20)_______. Don't hesitate to join one and enjoy your school life!

options: A. However, it also brings some challenges.
B. Besides making friends, you can learn new skills.
C. So find a club that interests you today.
D. There are many benefits to joining a club.
E. Then you will realize how fun school life can be.
questions.explanation: 本题考查过渡句与递进关系。上一段讲了First（第一点好处）交朋友，本段继续讲在科学社团可以学做实验，是第二点好处，故用Besides（除……之外还有）引出。B选项Besides making friends, you can learn new skills.承上启下，既总结上文（making friends），又引出下文（learn new skills对应做实验）。A选项表转折，与上文逻辑不符；C、D、E选项与段落位置和内容不符。解题技巧：注意连接词First、Besides、Moreover的递进序列，选项B的Besides与First、Moreover形成逻辑链条。
